How a visit runs

01

Book it

Send a request with the service and time you want. The shop confirms by email.

02

Cut it

Say what you want — fade, skin fade, clipper cut or full cut — and the barber cuts to that, not a generic shape.

03

Finish it

Beard tidy, hot towel shave or a $10 wash to finish, then you are out the door.
